name: The Perfect Piece
source:
You have always been the best in your art academy, Geika, and when an important art contest is announced, you are sure you will win; until a new student shows up.

That guy seems to be better than you in every way. He's popular, beautiful and talented, but something about him isn't right. You are determined to find out what he is hiding, but some secrets are best left buried...

[From [url=https://shogunyaru.itch.io/the-perfect-piece]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
芸香，你向来是艺术学院里最拔尖的学生。当学校宣布举办一场重要的艺术大赛时，你笃定冠军非你莫属——直到一名转学生突然出现。

那个家伙似乎在各个方面都压你一头。他备受欢迎、容貌出众又才华横溢，可他身上总透着一股说不出的古怪。你下定决心要查出他究竟隐藏着什么秘密，然而有些秘密，最好还是让它永远埋藏在暗处……

[摘自[url=https://shogunyaru.itch.io/the-perfect-piece]itch.io[/url]]
